args.sql:
SELECT 
    a.acctident AS account_id,
    ma.netinflscore AS overall_reach_score,
    cb.postfreq AS posting_frequency,
    ma.clustsize AS cluster_member_count,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ma.netinflscore DESC) AS influence_rank
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    moderationaction ma ON a.accindex = ma.macntref
JOIN 
    contentbehavior cb ON ma.macntref = cb.cntref
WHERE 
    ma.clustrole = 'Amplifier' 
    AND ma.netinflscore > (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY netinflscore) FROM moderationaction)
ORDER BY 
    ma.netinflscore DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    a.acctident AS account_id,
    ma.netinflscore AS overall_reach_score,
    cb.postfreq AS posting_frequency,
    ma.clustsize AS cluster_member_count,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ma.netinflscore DESC) AS influence_rank
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    moderationaction ma ON a.accindex = ma.macntref
JOIN 
    contentbehavior cb ON ma.macntref = cb.cntref
WHERE 
    ma.clustrole = 'Amplifier'
ORDER BY 
    ma.netinflscore DESC
LIMIT 10;
